items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Gerald, yeah. And I copied after them, too, in a sense.

ctx.x: So it was Wilcox and Sy Oliver, and then it was Gerald Wilson.

Gerald, yeah. And I copied after them, too, in a sense. I even copied after Duke, with the muted things that he had, with the section playing the mute -- it was a beautiful thing. A lot of bands didn't have that going on in there, so I picked up on a little bit of that. I didn't use much of it, but I mean, I got hip to it, so I knew that I wanted it I could draw back to it -- I could reach out and get that. Which is a great help when you're trying to put something together with all the different sounds and the…
